profile.headline: VP | Lead Software  Engineer at Wells Fargo

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Multiple Projects Using Tibco Product Suites for Wells Fargo Wholesale Customers.
TOPSS (Treasury Online Plus Shared Services) be shared web service provider, which exposes various services operations that satisfies Business Requirements to interact with wellsfargo back office applications for Check Inquiry Services, Stop Services and Image Services.

BLU (Bank Look UP Services) project develops a centralized data source and set of services for the receipt, update, storage, validation, and retrieval of financial institution detail data.  It also has the potential to become the enterprise source for Financial Institution detail data in the future. 

AES Enrollment System Project’s Objective is to route and auto-assign  SOF request to a specific IC based on characteristics of the customer, market segment, product complexity, workload, and Sales Officer alignments.

positions.title: Sr Software Consultant
positions.description:
Company Description: R+L Carriers is a global transportation provider of Less Than Truckload (LTL), Truckload (TL), Ocean and Air Cargo services. Worked on multiple projects using TIBCO.

ODS Project Description: The Operational Data Store (ODS) at R+L Carriers will provide a federated view of shipment transactional data using a canonical data model. The ODS will be used for both real-time operational reporting and data integration. Transactional integration with the Source Systems using SOA has been used to keep ODS current.

MDT Project Description: MDT Project deals with Driver Logging status using MDT Device, Online Dispatch, Tracking of truck using GPS Signal. This is a very complex project with multiple Tibco processes using Web Services, JMS and Database. Tibco BW is used to integrate MDT Device with MDT Server, Online Dispatch, Legacy systems and Mobile Database.
